narration.text: Humans flew around the Moon again in 2026.
Artemis II carried four astronauts on a lunar flyby.
Artemis IV, targeted for 2028, aims to land a crew.
From Artemis V, NASA plans yearly landings.
The goal is a permanent base, then Mars.
Every kilogram of supplies must be launched or made on site.
So a Moon base is really a supply chain problem.
The Moon becomes a rehearsal for living farther away.
